method: Exhaustive over 50 state codes; 2024-cycle = close_time in [2024-11-01T00:00:00Z, 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z); candles from market open through 1733011200 (daily, period_interval=1440), normalised verbatim to the 17-field integer-cents layout documented in src/kalshi-data.js.

AL.note: series exists but no market closed in the 2024 cycle window

MN.note: series exists but no market closed in the 2024 cycle window

SENATEAZ-24-R.title: Will Republicans win the Senate race in Arizona?
SENATEAZ-24-R.rules_primary: If Kari Lake or another representative of the Republican party is sworn in as a Senator of Arizona for the term beginning in 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
SENATEAZ-24-R.early_close_condition: This market will close early following the swearing in of the Senator for the seat in question.
